tilta - handheld support system for dji.description: Introducing the Handheld Support System for DJI Mavic 4 Pro. This Handheld Support System unlocks new creative possibilities by transforming your drone into a fully functional handheld camera rig.Perfect for filmmakers, content creators, and production teams on the go, this custom-designed camera cage offers a stable, ergonomic solution for ground-based shooting with the Mavic 4 Pro. Built with a modular design, the system supports a variety of configurations to match your specific needs, whether you're shooting handheld or mounting to a vehicle for dynamic 360 Degree roller shots.The base of the remote controller mount features a specialized clearance slot, allowing seamless integration of DJI audio accessories for high-quality, synced sound. Its ultra-lightweight construction and tool-free assembly make it an ideal companion for mobile workflows, allowing for fast setup and breakdown in any environment.Additional mounting points such as a Cold Shoe Receiver, 15mm Rod, Rosette and 1/4"-20 Threads with Locating Points, expand the potential for attaching various accessories such as on-board lights. Whether you're on set or out in the field, this support system brings flexibility, speed, and cinematic control to your aerial camera.Customizable Form Factors For Every NeedThe base of the remote controller mount features a clearance slot, designed specifically to accommodate DJI audio accessories for enhanced sound integration.Car Rig Set UpEasily achieve 360 roller shots on the go.Tool-Free Assembly. Ultra-Light PortabilityDesigned for creators on the move, the kit allows for quick setup and breakdown without the need for additional tools.Unlock the full potential of your Mavic 4 Pro.Effortlessly transition from drone to handheld camera, letting you shoot both aerial overviews and detailed scenes on the ground all with one setup.
